name: signalroom
description: A temporary command room for people and scripts.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @signalroom/server" "npm run dev -w @signalroom/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @signalroom/protocol && npm run build -w @signalroom/server && npm run build -w @signalroom/cli && npm run build -w @signalroom/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @signalroom/protocol && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @signalroom/protocol && npm run build -w @signalroom/server && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
